steps.what: Show which audio input is assigned to which channel.
Mix and regulate sound inputs and feeds with the television pictures.
Coordinate an audio feed that does not match those pictures.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows which audio input is already assigned to which channel. The audio technician mixes and regulates the sound inputs and feeds so they match the television pictures. A feed that does not match is held by the technician. The channel list does not move a fader. A desk with no stored assignment leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: Channel assignments were tape on the desk, and a late feed was found by ear during the item.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored assignment can be shown. The mix during the item stays at the desk.
tasks.still_hard: A feed can be on the right channel and still be the wrong sound for the picture.
tasks.human_edge: The technician mixes the sound and holds a feed that does not match the picture.
tasks.altitude: The mix stays at the desk with the technician. The channel assignment is only a map of what was plugged, not the mix itself.

reach.task: Hear a monitor mix and say whether it matches the song.
reach.learn: A channel number is not the mix.

evidence.claim: A stored channel assignment shows where an input was plugged. It does not mix or regulate the sound.
Holding a feed that fails the picture is the technician's decision in the moment. The assignment cannot hear the mismatch.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The desk id and the channel assignment if it is already stored. The assignment is not invented. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the assignment from the desk already in use before building a second map.
unknowns: Whether a separate audio operator, rather than this technician, owns the mix.
research_questions: Who calls a sound change against the picture, the director or the technician?

already_counted.description: Mixing the sound and holding a mismatched feed stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Update the channel map when an input is replugged.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still mixes and regulates the sound against the picture. Only showing a channel assignment already stored is removed. A desk with no assignment saves nothing of the mix.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the approved drawing for the set and the lighting.
Construct and position properties, sets, lighting equipment, and other equipment.
Stop when the room does not match the approved drawing.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the set and lighting drawing if one is already approved. The audio technician constructs and positions the properties, the set, and the lighting equipment by hand. The technician stops when the room does not match that drawing. The drawing does not build the set. A production with no approved drawing leaves the screen blank and the technician builds from the spoken brief.
tasks.previous_blocker: The drawing was a paper plan, and a room that did not match it was discovered while hanging the lights.
tasks.enabler_now: An approved drawing can be shown. Constructing and positioning the set stays physical.
tasks.still_hard: Weight, rigging points, and a room that is smaller than the drawing take the technician on site.
tasks.human_edge: The technician builds and positions the set, and stops when the room and the drawing disagree.
tasks.altitude: The build stays physical. The approved drawing is visible, and the technician still stops a build the room cannot hold.

reach.task: Position furniture from a drawing on the actual floor.
reach.learn: The drawing does not move the object.

evidence.claim: Showing an approved drawing is a lookup. It does not construct or position the set or the lighting.
Stopping a build the room cannot hold is the technician's decision on site. The drawing cannot see the room.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.
Fields: The production id and the drawing only if it is already approved. The drawing is not created here. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the drawing from the document store before printing a fresh copy.
unknowns: Whether rigging is done by this technician or by a venue crew.
research_questions: Who approves the drawing before the technician may build from it?

already_counted.description: Building the set and stopping a mismatch stay with the technician.

incremental.description: File the drawing against the production once the set is struck.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still constructs and positions the set and the lighting by hand. Only showing a drawing that is already approved is removed. A production with no drawing saves nothing of the build.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Reserve the room and the equipment.

steps.what: Show free meeting rooms and audio-visual facilities at the requested time.
Reserve audio-visual equipment and the meeting room.
File the accepted reservation for those facilities.

tasks.design: The {CALENDAR} shows meeting rooms and audio-visual facilities that are free at the requested time. The audio technician chooses and reserves the room and the equipment. The reservation is filed only after that acceptance, and only for that version. Two rooms free at the same time are not chosen by the screen. A request with no time is not searched. The screen does not reserve anything.
tasks.previous_blocker: Free rooms were read from a paper diary, and the booking was written a second time in the equipment book.
tasks.enabler_now: A calendar can show what is already free. The technician still chooses the room and the equipment.
tasks.still_hard: Two free rooms are not the same room when one lacks the equipment the meeting needs.
tasks.human_edge: The technician reserves the room and the equipment. The free list is not the reservation.
tasks.altitude: The technician still chooses the room and the equipment. Filing happens only for the reservation the technician has accepted.

reach.task: Book a pitch that is free and still suitable.
reach.learn: A free slot is not the booking.

evidence.claim: A calendar can list rooms already marked free at a requested time. It does not choose between them.
A reservation names the person who booked the room. That name is shown only to the technician who needs it to hold the room, which is ordinary booking data and not a special category.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The requested start, end, and the equipment type. A missing time stops the search. The free flag must already be on the calendar. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the company calendar already used for meeting rooms before adding a booking tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the audio technician.
unknowns: Whether facilities staff, rather than the technician, own the room calendar.
research_questions: Which equipment types are allowed to be reserved without a technician present?

already_counted.description: Choosing and reserving the room and the equipment stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Release reservations whose meeting was cancelled.

approvals.approved_version: reservation version and the room id it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still chooses the room and the equipment when more than one is free. Showing free rooms and filing the accepted reservation are the removed time. A request with no time saves nothing, because the search stops.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the objectives and the budgetary figure already agreed.
Determine formats, approaches, content, levels, and mediums within budgetary constraints.
Record the choice that uses the research, the training, and the knowledge.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the objectives and the budget figure if both are already agreed. The audio technician determines the format, the content, the level, and the medium within those constraints, using research and training already to hand. The technician writes the choice. The budget figure does not choose the format. An assignment with no agreed budget leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The budget was in one mail and the objective in another, and the format was chosen without both in view.
tasks.enabler_now: An agreed objective and budget can be shown together. Choosing the format stays with the technician.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which medium will meet the objective inside the budget is a judgement the figure cannot make.
tasks.human_edge: The technician determines the format and writes why it fits the constraints.
tasks.altitude: The format decision stays with the technician. The note records the choice the technician made, and the budget is only the constraint already agreed.

reach.task: Choose a treatment inside a budget someone else set.
reach.learn: The budget figure is not the creative choice.

evidence.claim: Showing an objective and a budget that are already agreed is a lookup. It does not determine the format or the medium.
The choice note is written by the technician. The budget figure does not contain the approach.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An audio and video technician in a mid-size European company. A stored equipment id is not a repair, and a draft is not the show.

Fields: The assignment id, the agreed objective, and the agreed budget figure. A missing budget stops the screen. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the audio technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read both from the document store already used for the assignment before opening a new brief.
unknowns: Whether research and training notes are already filed against the assignment.
research_questions: Who agrees the budget before the technician may choose a format?

already_counted.description: Choosing the format and writing the choice stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Close choice notes for assignments that were withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still determines the format, content, and medium within the budget, and still writes the choice. Only showing an objective and a budget that are already agreed is removed. A missing budget saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technician still mixes the sound, still builds the set, and still chooses the format within the budget. A free room can be shown from the calendar, and the reservation is filed only after the technician accepts it.
reach: Musicians and singers hear the mix in the room, and this job learns the mix is not a channel list.
Interior designers position a set, and this job learns the build stays physical.
skills_to_grow: Mix sound against the picture, not against the channel list.
Build and position the set from the drawing by hand.
Accept a room and an equipment set before the reservation is filed.
role.ambitious_version: Live mixing and set building stay at the technician's hands. A reservation is filed only for the room and the equipment the technician has accepted.
